updating [compose.yaml](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-neon/03-infra-management/compose.yaml) and [.env.example](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-neon/03-infra-management/.env.example) to remove embedded credentials and public `db`/`cache`/`api` ports, enforce fail-fast environment variables and Redis/Postgres auth, segment traffic across `frontend` and `internal: true` `backend` networks, persist Postgres via a `postgres_data` volume, add health checks with `service_healthy` dependencies, and apply restart, log-rotation, privilege-drop, and resource limits; hardening [nginx.conf](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-neon/03-infra-management/nginx.conf) for unprivileged JSON API proxying with proper forwarding/security headers, HTTP/1.1 keepalive, API timeouts, JSON error pages, and a local-only `/nginx-health` endpoint;
